sloka: ततः शतसहस्रैश्च कोटिभिश्च सहस्रशः ।वानराणाम् सुघोराणाम् श्रीमत्परिवृता मही ॥६-४-६९॥।।
transliteration: tataḥ śatasahasraiśca koṭibhiśca sahasraśaḥ ।vānarāṇām sughorāṇām śrīmatparivṛtā mahī ॥6-4-69॥।।

translations.english: Formidable vanaras in hundreds, thousands, lakhs and crores spread in a splendid manner around the land.
